caption: Smoke rises from a house chimney on a calm winter evening and thins out as it climbs.

sa.check: Smoke comes out of a house chimney.
It thins out as it climbs.
The evening is calm, so the column stays near vertical.

pc.fail: It sinks to the ground; or hangs at chimney height; or flows down the roof.

pc.expect: It widens and thins with height and does not gather back.
pc.fail: It gathers back into the chimney; or gets denser higher up; or forms a solid shape.

pc.expect: On a calm evening the column drifts gently with no sharp turns.
pc.fail: It whips sideways; or jumps; or a piece detaches and drifts as a block.

pc.expect: The smoke is diffuse, translucent and swirling.
pc.fail: It is a solid shape; or a liquid; or a rigid stick.
Smoke appears elsewhere; or the chimney duplicates; or the smoke vanishes all at once.

pc.expect: The house, the roof and the sky stay the same.
pc.fail: The house changes; or the roof rearranges; or the sky changes colour.
